    • sevenelements$getTrueName

      public final net.minecraft.network.chat.Component sevenelements$getTrueName()
      Description copied from interface: IItemStack
      Returns the custom name of the stack if it exists, or the item's name. This is the unmodified version of ItemStack.getHoverName(), and should only be used in contexts where the stack's name is being edited.
      Specified by:

    • sevenelements$hasElementalGlint

      public final boolean sevenelements$hasElementalGlint()
      Description copied from interface: IItemStack
      Checks if an elemental glint effect should be applied when the item stack is rendered. This is affected by the value of the DataComponents.ENCHANTMENT_GLINT_OVERRIDE component.

      By default, returns true if the stack has an elemental infusion or if IItemStack.sevenelements$hasAttunementGlint() is true.

      Specified by:
      sevenelements$hasElementalGlint in interface IItemStack

    • sevenelements$hasAttunementGlint

      public final boolean sevenelements$hasAttunementGlint()
      Description copied from interface: IItemStack
      Checks if the elemental attunement glint effect should be applied when the item stack is rendered. This is affected by the value of the DataComponents.ENCHANTMENT_GLINT_OVERRIDE component.

      By default, returns true if the stack has an elemental attunement that matches its elemental infusion or if the stack contains the DataComponents.EQUIPPABLE component.

      Specified by:
      sevenelements$hasAttunementGlint in interface IItemStack
